thread:
alex: FYI we're scheduling a base image rebuild + key rotation window. Main ask: design an ephemeral signing helper (narrow network, limited IAM) for cases where direct cosign->KMS is blocked. Need RBAC, network, audit, and vuln-triage checklist. cc @priya @luis
priya: High level plan: 1) builder SA: build/push only, no key usage. 2) signer SA: run in signed-subnet with KMS decrypt+encrypt only. 3) ephemeral helper: short-lived pod that gets a 1h signed token to wrap keys if HSM prevents direct cosign.
luis: For RBAC: add k8s Role `base-builder` with no access to secrets holding KMS creds. `image-signer` gets permission to mount KMS token secret and call KMS:Decrypt. Also add OPA gate to reject any RoleBinding that puts builders in signer group.
hana: Audit/logging: ensure cosign and helper emit structured JSON with fields: operation, key_id, signer_principal, image_digest, result. Route to splunk index `sec:images` and to auditpipe. Retention: 365d prod, 90d staging. Make sure Splunk field extraction maps signer_principal.
alex: Vulnerability triage: before rebuild we must run dependency-scan and SBOM diff. If high-severity changes appear between old and new base, pause rebuild and create a mitigation ticket. QA: add canary nodes to validate runtime behavior and sig verification.
qa-bot: test-run: staging-rebuild-2026-05-04 queued. Tests: sbom-diff, cosign-verify, runtime-smoke.
priya: KMS notes: on some clouds HSM-backed keys cannot export or be used by third-party binaries. If cosign binary can't talk to HSM directly, the helper will call KMS:Sign and return signature. Helper must be ephemeral, run in prod VPC, and require `audited=required` SA annotation.
luis: IAM condition idea: allow `kms:Decrypt` where request.time < rotation_window_end && resource.name == projects/redwood/keys/base-signing. I'll draft condition and post. Also enable key versions so we can roll back to prev version if rotation fails.
hana: Rollback playbook: 1) Halt new deployments, 2) Keep previous signed images promoted, 3) Revert key version to previous version, 4) Run signature verification job across clusters, 5) Re-run rotation in maintenance window. Need oncall contact.
sec-bot: alert: key-rotation-preflight missing splitting-check (run preflight.sh)
alex: Preflight checklist (short): RBAC diffs reviewed, OPA webhook deployed, KMS IAM condition drafted, audit routing tested, SBOM baseline captured, canary policies ready, rollback owner assigned.
priya: OPA webhook snippet (concept):
```
package rbac
deny[msg] {
  input.binding.subject.kind == "ServiceAccount"
  input.binding.subject.name == "base-builder"
  some r
  input.binding.role.rules[r].contains("keys/decrypt")
  msg = "builders must not have KMS decrypt"
}
```
luis: Also add registry retention: protect last 50 signed tags per base image and mark them immutable for 7 days post-rotation. Prevent accidental GC.
hana: Vulnerability triage escalation: if any CVE >= 8.0 appears in sbom diff, automatically open ticket to security-triage and block rollout. Add automated label `triage:blocking` from scanner.
alex: Who's primary for rotation night? I'll be primary, @luis backup. Oncall contact: ops-oncall.
qa-bot: scheduled canary run: canary-verify-1743219999 -> pending
priya: One more: ensure helper logs include caller identity and pod UID so we can correlate KMS audit logs to k8s objects.
luis: I'll create PR with RBAC + IAM condition + registry retention rules. TAG: please review in 48h.
alex: Great. If nothing else, I'll post the invite and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
hana: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated if you find blockers
